newsitem.title: INDIA: Bombay share index rebounds 5.1 pct at close.
newsitem.headline: Bombay share index rebounds 5.1 pct at close.

text.p: 142.86 points, or 5.10 percent up at a provisional
2,941.43 ** Market boosted by Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's promise
to review a controversial tax on firms ** Upsurge helped by hectic short covering-traders ** National exchange index gains 35.79 points, or 4.46
Share prices bounced back on Wednesday at Bombay bourses helped by big boost to sentiment from Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda, brokers said.
They said the rebound was powered by Deve Gowda's assurance to review a controversial minimum alternate tax on firms.
"Psychologically, it's a big morale booster," said Bharat Iyer, market strategist at UBS Securities, the investment arm of Union Bank of Switzerland. "It is very positive."
Deve Gowda told captains of industry in New Delhi on Tuesday he would review the tax which the businessmen blamed for slowing industrial growth and company profits.
"About your point on taxation, we have taken note for consideration when next year's budget is being formulated," the prime minister had said.
India's budget for fiscal 1997/98 (April-March) is normally presented to parliament in late February.
"If he (the prime minister) acts on the statement the market will boom," said Bhaskar Hingad, director at Panorama Share and Stock Brokers Ltd. "The tax was a thorn."
Traders said hectic short covering and selective institutional buying pulled prices higher.
Kotak Securities chief dealer Ketan Jhaveri said the rebound was boosted by hectic short covering, but the sharp rise could prove the market's undoing.
"If the market hadn't moved so abruptly we could have hoped for a sustained turnaround," he said. "I'm sceptical."
He said domestic and foreign institutions were active buyers during the day.

ACC rose 83 rupees to 1,040, Bajaj Auto 49.25 to 722.25, TELCO 22 to 328, SBI 12.25 to 216.50, Indian Hotel 34 to 678, Hindustan Lever 31.25 to 805, Gujarat Ambuja Cement 20.50 to 228, Reliance 13.75 to 194.75 and TISCO 10.75 to 160.75.
